title: Act 0: Wake-Up Protocol
setting: Earth Orbital Drydock, Ares Staging Platform
description: Onboard diagnostics reboot while the Commander shakes off cryo-lag.

steps.instruction: Steer through the green navigation ring ahead.
steps.controlsHint: Desktop: W/S for thrust, A/D to strafe, Mouse to steer | Mobile: Left stick to move, drag right to look
steps.spokenLine: Systems coming online. Shake off that cryo-lag, Commander, and steer us through that green ring ahead.

steps.instruction: Engage afterburners to clear the secondary ring.
steps.controlsHint: Desktop: Hold Shift | Mobile: Tap and hold Boost button
steps.spokenLine: Engines are still cold. Hold down the boost and punch through the next ring before our orbital window slips.

steps.instruction: Activate your comms and summon a supply crate.
steps.controlsHint: Desktop: Hold V or Space (or tap mic button) | Mobile: Tap big mic button | Text: Use quick chip
steps.spokenLine: My language core is warming up. Let us test reality fabricators. Say: NOVA, summon a supply crate.

steps.instruction: Ask NOVA to repair the hull damage from drydock release.
steps.controlsHint: Speak naturally or tap a quick command
steps.spokenLine: Hull micro-sensors took a nick during drydock release. Try asking me to fix it in your own words.

steps.instruction: Test NOVA's generative fabricator. Ask for anything you want.
steps.controlsHint: Try summoning an escort, a space creature, a shield, or something silly
steps.spokenLine: Final calibration, Commander. Ask me for anything you can imagine. Let us see how flexible my fabricator array really is.
